comment: Everything the player can hold. `contraband` items fail a search and are confiscated on arrest. `icon` indexes the sheet produced by tools/gen_art.py.

items.name: Ration tin
items.description: Galley issue. Keeps you upright through a double shift.

items.name: Scrap plate
items.description: Offcut from the sludge line. Nobody counts these.

items.name: Deck wrench
items.description: Signed out for shift work. Signed back in, usually.

items.name: Oxygen bottle
items.description: Twenty minutes of breathing where there is none.

items.name: Torch fuel
items.description: Decanted from the welding bay. Explains itself badly.

items.name: Cutting torch
items.description: Opens hatches that were not meant to open.

items.name: Nav module
items.description: Without it, a submersible surfaces somewhere random.

items.name: Drive housing
items.description: One of three. Heavy, and shaped like nothing else on the rig.

items.name: Drive impeller
items.description: Two of three. Bent blades, still turns.

items.name: Drive core
items.description: Three of three. Warm to the touch, which is not reassuring.

items.name: Blank docket
items.description: Rotation paperwork, unsigned. Worthless until it is not.

items.name: Forged rotation docket
items.description: Says you are owed a berth on the supply sub.

items.name: Security uniform
items.description: One size too big and missing a name tag.

items.name: Maintenance keycard
items.description: Opens the workshop. Does not open anything interesting.

items.name: Patched rebreather
items.description: Scrubs your own air back at you. Buys a long minute.

items.name: Door shim
items.description: Convinces a powered door it has already been authorised.
